name: iShares Silver Trust (Ondo Tokenized)
oneLiner: SLVon is Ondo's tokenized iShares Silver Trust exposure, a NAV-style ETF tracker for non-U.S. investors rather than a $1 stablecoin.
collateral: Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF exposure referencing iShares Silver Trust (SLV), designed to provide economic exposure to the underlying publicly traded ETF through Ondo GM rather than direct ownership of ETF shares
pegMechanism: NAV-style tokenized ETF tracker rather than a $1 peg; subscriptions, redemptions, and market pricing follow the underlying SLV economic exposure through Ondo Global Markets and eligible investor flows

mintAuthority.summary: SLVon is a centrally issued Ondo Global Markets tokenized ETF tracker. On Ethereum the token has MINTER_ROLE held by GMTokenManager (Ondo's issuance contract) and OndoOFT (LayerZero bridge). DEFAULT_ADMIN is a TimelockController (minDelay=0) controlled by a 9-signer Ondo governance Safe (5-of-9). Full Ondo GM multisig governance confirmed.

controls.label: Ondo Global Markets issuance backend
controls.evidence: Ondo GM mints/redeems SLVon against custodied SLV economic exposure for eligible investors only; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists and eligibility/transfer restrictions are enforced by the issuer.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (MINTER_ROLE[0])
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295049, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) on SLVon ETH returned 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c. Contract verified as GMTokenManager (Ondo's Global Markets issuance contract) on Blockscout.

controls.label: OndoOFT (MINTER_ROLE[1] — bridge)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295049, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) returned 0xf9deffd6164d2b6714f3344cfc35c4f766fa9d6e. Contract verified as OndoOFT (LayerZero OFT bridge) on Blockscout. Enables cross-chain supply bridging.

controls.label: TimelockController DEFAULT_ADMIN (minDelay=0)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295049, getRoleMember(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0) on SLVon ETH returned 0x3715b2154d2ff4c5b027c7a1f734b53f27bc34f1. Verified as TimelockController (minDelay=0 via getMinDelay()). TimelockController admin includes the Ondo governance Safe 0xcd35671... (9-owner 5/9, no modules). PROPOSER = Ondo Safe 0x71a4d411... (7-owner 4/7, no modules). Zero minDelay means no effective time-lock delay.

controls.label: Ondo governance Safe — TimelockController admin (5-of-9)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295049: getRoleMember(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 1) on TimelockController 0x3715b2154d2ff4c5b027c7a1f734b53f27bc34f1 returned 0xcd35671dcab88d05ee29dc4d360181529390b17f. getOwners() confirmed 9 owners; slot 4 = threshold 5; slot 0 = 0xd9db270c... review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295049: SLVon ETH (0xf3e4872e6a4cf365888d93b6146a2baa7348f1a4) has no EIP-1967 proxy slots (admin=0, impl=0) — direct non-proxy contract. MINTER_ROLE count=2: GMTokenManager (0x2c158bc...) and OndoOFT (0xf9deffd...) confirmed via getRoleMember() and Blockscout source names. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE count=1: TimelockController 0x3715b2154... with minDelay=0. TimelockController's DEFAULT_ADMIN[1] = Ondo 9-owner Safe 5/9 (0xcd35671..., Gnosis 1.3.0, no modules). TimelockController PROPOSER[0] = Ondo 7-owner Safe 4/7 (0x71a4d411...). Full Ondo GM governance chain confirmed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: SLVon is an Ondo Global Markets token, and Ondo documents its token bridge as a LayerZero-based bridge for Global Markets assets, including bridging to HyperEVM. Pharos scores this as external lock/mint/OFT-style route exposure.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: SLVon resolves to Yes because it is a centrally issued Ondo GM tokenized ETF product with eligibility restrictions and issuer-controlled subscription, redemption, and transfer infrastructure.

reserves.name: iShares Silver Trust (SLV) economic exposure via Ondo Global Markets collateral accounts

notices.title: Tokenized ETF exposure
notices.message: Ondo GM Tokens provide economic exposure to the underlying ETF but do not give holders direct rights to hold or receive the underlying ETF shares; eligibility restrictions apply.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: SLVon is a tokenized fund-security exposure tracking the iShares Silver Trust through Ondo Global Markets, not allocated physical bullion.
